summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an off-market buyback of 6,600,000 Class A Ordinary Shares from a non-affiliated private holder at a price below the recent NYSE American trading price, representing 50% of the 13.2 million share mandate authorized by the Board on June 7, 2026. The repurchased shares will be canceled, reducing issued capital. The company targets up to an additional 36.7 million shares for removal, totaling 43.3 million shares (approx. 36% of public float). A further buyback mandate of up to 20% of issued shares will be proposed at the AGM on July 7, 2026. The transaction aims to increase Net Asset Value per Share (NAVPS) and close the discount to NAV. The remaining mandate expires July 6, 2026. Watch for the pace of further repurchases and the AGM vote on the new mandate.
